candidates.topic: Last Quarter Moon in Taurus — Letting Go of Comfort
candidates.teaser: The Moon in Taurus right now is forcing a choice most people aren't ready to make.
candidates.video_title: Last Quarter Moon in Taurus — The Hardest Release
candidates.video_description: The Last Quarter Moon in Taurus asks you to release what feels safe but no longer serves you. Comfort can be a trap. This lunation demands honest reassessment before the next cycle begins.
candidates.script: The Last Quarter Moon in Taurus is here — and it's asking you to let go of exactly the thing you're most afraid to lose. Taurus energy clings. It holds on to comfort, routine, security — even when those things have quietly become a cage. Astrologically, Last Quarter Moons are crisis points, not endings. The question isn't what's over. The question is: what are you still holding because it feels safe? Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Rules Under Revision
candidates.teaser: Saturn is retrograde in Aries right now — and it's rewriting the rules you thought were permanent.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Your Rules Are Being Rewritten
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde in Aries turns discipline inward — forcing a review of boundaries, ambitions, and the structures you built on impulse. Some foundations are solid. Others are about to crack.
candidates.script: Saturn is retrograde in Aries right now — sitting at 13 degrees — and in astrology, that combination is ruthless. Aries wants to charge forward. Saturn retrograde drags everything backward for review. The structures you built fast, the boundaries you drew on impulse, the version of ambition you never questioned — all of it is up for renegotiation. This isn't punishment. Astrologers call this the cosmic audit you can't cheat. What rule in your life was never really yours to begin with?

candidates.topic: Three Outer Planets Retrograde — Neptune & Pluto Join Saturn
candidates.teaser: Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde at the same time — and astrologers say this doesn't happen quietly.
candidates.video_title: 3 Outer Planets Retrograde Right Now — What It Means
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto are simultaneously retrograde in September 2026. Each one governs a different layer of reality — structure, illusion, and transformation. When all three pull back at once, astrology calls it a collective turning point.
candidates.script: Saturn, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde right now — simultaneously — and in astrology, that is not background noise. Saturn at 13 Aries is auditing your structures. Neptune at 3 Aries is dissolving the stories you told yourself about who you are. Pluto at 3 Aquarius is pulling transformation underground, where you can't see it yet. Three different layers of reality — all reversing at once. Astrologers say this is when the shift happens inside before it ever shows up outside. Can you feel it?

candidates.topic: The North Node — The Point in Your Chart You Keep Ignoring
candidates.teaser: There's one point in your birth chart that literally maps your soul's direction — and most people have never even looked at it.
candidates.video_title: Your North Node — The Most Ignored Point in Your Chart
candidates.video_description: The North Node isn't a planet — it's a mathematical point that astrologers interpret as your life's karmic direction. It shows where you're supposed to grow, not where you're comfortable. Most people instinctively avoid it.
candidates.script: Your North Node is not a planet — it doesn't even physically exist — but in astrology, it might be the most important point in your entire birth chart. It marks the direction your life is supposed to pull toward in this lifetime. The catch? Astrologers say it always feels deeply uncomfortable, because it's the opposite of what comes naturally to you. Your South Node is your default. Your North Node is your assignment. Most people spend their whole lives choosing the easy one. Which one are you living?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Virgo — The Sign It Rules and Why It's Different Here
candidates.teaser: Mercury is in Virgo right now — the one sign where it operates at a completely different level.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Virgo — Why This Placement Hits Different
candidates.video_description: Mercury rules Virgo, which means right now it's operating in its home territory — sharper, faster, and more analytical than almost anywhere else in the zodiac. But astrologers warn that this clarity has a shadow side.
candidates.script: Mercury is in Virgo right now — at 15 degrees — and this placement is different from every other sign, because Virgo is one of the signs Mercury actually rules. In astrology, a planet in its home sign operates without interference. The mind gets sharper. Pattern recognition goes up. Communication becomes precise, almost surgical. But here's what astrologers rarely mention: Mercury in Virgo can turn that precision on yourself — and become the loudest inner critic you've ever had. Is your mind solving problems right now, or just finding new ones?
